監察院所彈劾之公務人員如涉及刑事責任時，亦由監察院予以審理

mcq.q: 依憲法規定、司法院釋字與憲法法庭判決之見解，有關選舉制度，下列敘述何者錯誤？
opts: 憲法上所規定之選舉，原則上以普通、平等、直接及無記名投票之方法行之
修憲機關所定之選舉方法不得有礙民主共和國及國民主權原則之實現，亦不得變動選舉權、平等權之核心內涵

mcq.q: 依地方制度法規定，關於直轄市、縣（市）之改制或合併，下列敘述何者錯誤？

opts: 於修正施行前依法選編之判例，一律失去裁判之效力

mcq.q: 有關國民法官制度之相關規定，下列敘述何者正確？

國民法官僅就案件事實是否有罪進行討論與表決，法律適用與科刑並非國民法官之權限

mcq.q: 下列有關英美法與大陸法之敘述，何者錯誤？

Not only has communication become faster, but it has also become more 42 —people now use images, emojis, videos, and voice messages to express themselves. Online forums, blogs, and video-sharing sites have new forms of interaction, enabling people from different cultures to engage in meaningful conversations. Nevertheless, the rise of digital communication has also raised concerns about privacy, cyberbullying, and mental health. Constant connectivity can 43 information overload and feelings of isolation. The curated nature of online identities may contribute to low self-esteem, particularly among younger users who compare themselves to unrealistic portrayals on social media. In this digital era, it is, 44 , important to strike a balance between online and offline interactions. Spending time face-to-face with family and friends helps 45 emotional bonds and enhances real-life social skills. Setting boundaries for screen time and practicing digital detox can also improve one’s mental well-being.
